string.text:
The Vepr KM is a semi-automatic civilian hunting carbine chambered in 7.62x39mm. Built from a de-militarised Kalashnikov AKM, and with nearly identical appearance, weight and dimensions; it was designed for sporting use, and for hunting medium and big game.
 
This civilianised rifle lacks standard military features such as a dovetail mount and barrel threading for suppressors. 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[d_red] mounting suppressors is not possible
 %c[d_purple] • %c[d_red] mounting scopes is not possible
